Facing Small Fears

For anyone who lets small fears make their world a little smaller. Each day is one gentle, manageable step toward something that feels a bit scary, taken at your own pace and with kindness.

Anxiety · Anxiety · Motivation · Self-Compassion · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Tell yourself, kindly, that almost everyone has a few small things that feel a little scary, and that you are in good company.
  • Day 2Smile at one person you pass today, if it feels okay, and let that be your whole step for now.
  • Day 3Scroll back to a friendly message someone once sent you, and let it remind you that people are often glad to hear from you.
  • Day 4Jot down one tiny new thing you might enjoy trying, like a new song or a craft you have seen, with no need to do it yet.
  • Day 5Breathe in slowly and out even more slowly, just once, before anything else today.
  • Day 6Spot one small thing you put off today because it felt uncomfortable, and jot it down without judging it.
  • Day 7Ask a store employee where one item is, even if you could find it yourself, and thank them warmly.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Plan your next small step and write it on a sticky note where you will see it.
  • Day 60Text a friend after you face something small, sharing it as good news.
  • Day 120Stroll slowly around the block after a step to let the feeling settle.
  • Day 240Practice a small step at home first, like saying your coffee order out loud in the kitchen.
  • Day 365Be proud of every small step you have taken, and choose gently where to go next.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
